column1: # stderiv_vectors.tsv -- the stderiv transform (spatial derivative, int16
# clamp, temporal first-difference seeded by the sample before the window),
# one row per case.  neurosuite-3 runs it in core_test_stderiv_vectors
# (fiber_stderiv.apply_stderiv_transform).  The two copies must stay byte-identical
# (test_shared_contract).  Rows were generated from neurosuite-3's core and
# checked against the extractor's own arithmetic (process_extractspikes_stderiv
# computeSDiff + fill_sdiff_buffer as of 0639); do not regenerate them to make a
# change pass -- a changed row is a changed file format.
#   order   spatial order: 0 none, 1 first, 2 Laplacian, 3 all-pairs,
#   map     '-' (no map; for 4/5/6 the pattern does not fit -> all-pairs),
#           order 5: one set per channel, members joined by '+' ('1+2 0+2 ...'),
#   prev    the raw sample before the window, one value per channel; sample 0's
#           temporal difference is taken against its spatial derivative
#   input   the raw window, CHANNEL-MAJOR: channel 0's nSamp samples, then 1's ...
#   output  the stderiv window, channel-major int16
